phases.summary: Ternary ISA, assembler, VM widths, integer formats, native ops, and numeric workloads have regression coverage.

SSA IR is the sole target-code source; global optimization, graph coloring/coalescing, iterative spills, aggregate-pointer ABI and call-clobber contracts, runtime wrappers, linking, and TCL assembly have focused and quantitative coverage.
Native kernel, VFS, persistent root image, checkpoint-durable namespace/quota policy, process lifecycle, waits, and app handoff are implemented with production tests.
open_items: Add VFS allocator reclamation/compaction and rename
Dedicated fuzz harness for syscalls with malformed pointers

phases.summary: Host SDL runner boots release images, routes input, decodes framebuffer snapshots, and exports diagnostics.
open_items: Full guest diagnostics beyond syscall events

phases.summary: Host tools, manifests, debugging docs, diagnostic bundle contracts, Obsidian vault validation, and Graphify-backed knowledge graph tooling now exist for recursive agent loops.
open_items: Add randomized syscall coverage for malformed pointers
Extend diagnostics with guest checkpoints and external input event provenance
Keep Obsidian vault links and canvas current as docs evolve
Broaden Graphify/Trit graph augmentation beyond files, functions, constants, structs, imports, syscalls, and direct call edges

phases.summary: Use deterministic Doom-class interactive and BitNet-style inference workloads as OS capability and performance baselines before importing full external assets.
open_items: Import or adapt a minimal Doom renderer and redistributable WAD assets
Scale the BitNet workload from the deterministic 27x27 model to sliced and then full model shards
Archive controlled-host timing baselines before enforcing tighter workload regressions

phases.summary: Formalize ASCII, UTF-8, and hexadecimal as compatibility encodings while designing ternary-native text and compact numeric notations.
open_items: Specify a fixed TASCII-81 table for basic guest text
Specify exact trit literal syntax and compact base-27 or base-81 dump notation
Add conversion APIs in host tools and the app SDK
Add assembler and TCL parser tests for decimal, hex, ASCII, UTF-8, and future ternary-native literals
Teach dump tools to print ternary-native notation alongside host hexadecimal
